title: AFG Church redesign
question: Choose a direction while I prepare the CMS and content migration.

options.label: The gathering hall
options.thesis: A welcoming church gathering, translated into generous space and real community photography.
options.viewport: A large invitation beside a congregation photo, with Sunday time immediately visible.
options.risk: Needs strong real photographs to avoid feeling too quiet.

raised.raise: Make the Sunday invitation unmistakable at first glance.
Keep the same disciplined proportions across every section.
Give visitors a clear path from welcome to visit.
Keep interaction paths continuous and readable.
Compose the page as one connected experience.
Make service facts easy to compare in a single row.

options.label: The welcome table
options.thesis: An intimate, photograph-led introduction to the church family.
options.viewport: A broad church photograph and a simple welcome, followed by an immediate visit panel.
options.risk: A familiar church website structure, though effective.

options.label: Theatre poster
options.thesis: A Sunday invitation framed like an event poster.
options.viewport: A Sunday invitation framed like an event poster.
options.risk: The metaphor distracts from a practical church visit.
options.case: Lower church identification and less immediate visitor clarity than the gathering hall.
options.kept: Make the Sunday invitation unmistakable at first glance.
